ItemID: NA; Title: City of Evil Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The melodic metal and energetic guitar work fit my interest in heavy music with strong hooks.
ItemID: NA; Title: Curse; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its mix of aggressive vocals and melody fits my recent In Flames listening, so I would try it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Inhuman Rampage; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The fast guitar work appeals, but I am more interested in groove and darker moods this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Unhallowed; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic death metal connects with Colony, but I would save this heavier choice for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Crusade; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its riff-driven metal sounds like a good follow-up to Advance And Vanquish.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Beautiful Letdown; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its lighter alternative rock direction is less appealing while I am looking for heavier music.
ItemID: NA; Title: Infest Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The aggression fits part of my taste, but I would choose more melodic hard rock today.
ItemID: NA; Title: One-X; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The heavy, emotional hard rock fits my interest in One Day Remains and Ten Thousand Fists.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sing The Sorrow; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The dark melodies appeal, but its punk direction is less compelling than the metal choices right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Healthy In Paranoid Times; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I enjoyed the direction represented by my Elocation interaction and would explore another Our Lady Peace album.
